provenance.source_description: demo 01 model 4: a Choice over the DOCTOR script's rules, learned from Weizenbaum's own decisions on 7,595 oracle-labelled inputs (novel dialogue, everyday lines, generated frames), with three Noul heads (question, negative, positive) trained on masked labels over the shared encoder and question marks made visible; an exact vocabulary of the 2,000 most frequent training words and bigrams; one Adam run (lr 0.01, label smoothing 0.1, minibatches of 256, 30% word dropout on alternate batches) from seeded random initialization, snapshotted when the measured training clock passed 0 s, 10 s, 1 min, 5 min and 10 min on an M1 Max with mlpl-repl 0.22.0. Embedding rounded to 1e-3, heads to 1e-4.
